items.title: Arthur Baron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Trump’s feeling about it is I’m going to have law and order

ctx.x: It’s here. Everything is like, no more. And here the answer is, I’m not saying all police are bad, but the answer for a lot of the municipalities is like you know their police get wartime army weapons. You know that’s somehow — the illegality of that has been circumvented. Or maybe it’s not illegal everywhere. And it’s just gotten so like Trump’s feeling about it is I’m going to have law and order I don’t care how many people I have to kill or tear gas. It’s just absurd, his rule, it’s totally absurd.
